name: Gatto Mammone
body:
Gatto Mammone
CR 9

This creature could appear like an ordinary housecat, except for its huge proportions. A deep, purring voice forms words in the common tongue while it advances soundlessly towards you on its powerful paws.

XP 6,400
N Huge magical beast
Init +9; Senses darkvision 60 ft., dreamsight, low-light vision; Perception +19; Aura frightful presence (30 ft., DC 21)

DEFENSE

AC 123, touch 14, flat-footed 17 (+4 Dex, +2 size)
hp 114 (12d10+48)
Fort +12, Ref +13, Will +8
Defensive Abilities dream armor; DR 10/magic; Immune confusion, sleep; SR 20

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., climb 20 ft.
Melee bite +17 (2d6+7), 2 claws +17 (1d8+7 plus grab)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks command cats 8/day (DC 21)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 12th; concentration +17)

At will—chameleon scales, discern lies (DC 19), invisibility (self only), lullaby (DC 15)
3/day—dream, nightmare (DC 20)
1/day—dream travel (DC 21), summon (level 3, 1d20 common cats or 1d6 cat sith, 50%)

STATISTICS

Str 24, Dex 21, Con 19, Int 19, Wis 18, Cha 20
Base Atk +12; CMB +21; CMD 36 (can’t be tripped)
Feats Dodge, Improved Initiative, Intimidating Prowess, Mobility, Skill Focus (Stealth), Spring Attack
Skills Acrobatics +20, Climb +22, Intimidate +24, Perception +19, Sense Motive +16, Stealth +26
Languages Abyssal, Common, Elven, Infernal, Sylvan; telepathy 60 ft.

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Command Cats (Su)

As a standard action, a gatto mammone can utter a powerful meow that bends to its will feline animals and magical beasts within 30 feet, as a 12th-level cleric using the Command Animals feat.
Target creatures receive a Will save to negate the effect. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Dream Armor (Su)

A gatto mammone is immune to all spells that cause sleep or affect dreams.

Dreamsight (Su)

A gatto mammone knows the location of all sleeping creatures within 500 feet, including those using meditation or trances, or similar restful activities that replace sleep.

ECOLOGY

Environment any (Material Plane or Dimension of Dreams)
Organization solitary or accompanied by a court of 1-60 common cats and 1-20 cat sith
Treasure double

The bigger and more powerful relative of cat sith, the gatto mammone is considered the king of all felines. There is only one gatto mammone, but it can appear in any fur pattern or color it wishes, often choosing a tabby pattern or an all-black coat with a white M on its muzzle. It is at ease both with a bipedal and a four-legged stance.

The gatto mammone is variously seen as a demonic creature or a judge and tester of the fey. According to legends, it can guard immense treasures to give to the worthy, but is mostly associated with dreams, nightmares, and punishing bad behavior. It is said to send bad dreams to evil humans and naughty kids. Mothers will say to children that won’t sleep: “Lullaby, go to sleep, for the Mammone comes!”. They will also teach them charms to keep the great cat away. In other stories, the gatto mammone keeps court in the woods or in the Dimension of Dreams, testing the character and morals of wanderers who search or bump into him. The good will be rewarded, bad or uneducated ones will be punished or cursed. The gatto mammone can also appear in dreams to warn mortals of some great danger or adventure incoming. All stories agree that every cat can be a messenger of the gatto mammone, and whoever mistreats a cat risks incurring its wrath and revenge.
